description: This line plot, titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = small,” illustrates the change in Word Error Rate (WER) across six epochs for four different fine-tuning configurations of the Whisper model. The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis represents WER, scaled linearly from 25.0 to 42.5, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5. Four distinct lines are plotted: “small AdaLoRA_int4” is shown as a dashed brown line with circle markers, starting at a WER of approximately 35.6 and decreasing to about 30.1; “small AdaLoRA_int8” is a solid brown line with square markers, beginning at a WER of 30.0 and decreasing to 25.0; “small int4” is a dashed brown line with circle markers, starting at a WER of 35.6 and decreasing to 25.0; and “small int8” is a solid brown line with square markers, beginning at a WER of 30.0 and decreasing to 25.0. All lines show a general downward trend in WER as epochs increase, with the “small int4” and “small int8” lines showing a more pronounced decline compared to the AdaLoRA variants.
